name: Tapstitch
summary: Fashion-first print-on-demand for brand-builders: premium heavyweight blanks (streetwear tees, oversized hoodies), bigger print areas and made-to-order apparel with no inventory. Integrates with Shopify.
best_for: creators building a real apparel or streetwear brand who care about fabric, fit and how the product feels in hand
skip_if: you want the cheapest option or the widest catalogue: for pure margin and product breadth, traditional POD like Printify wins
honest_knock: Printify is cheaper, higher-margin and has a far bigger catalogue, if you're optimising for profit per sale or product breadth, that's the real trade-off. Tapstitch earns its place when garment quality and brand feel matter more than squeezing the last point of margin.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 in our own Tapstitch account, prices shown in euros; US dollar figures verified 2026-10-12 on tapstitch.com/collections/all; the site publishes no pricing page, and tapstitch.com/pricing returns 404) No subscription, no monthly fee and no minimum order quantity — you pay per item, production plus shipping, so there is no plan price to compare. The all-products page lists 1,244 items, 48 to a page across 26 pages; in US dollars their 'from' prices run from $2.99 to $38.99, median $14.99, at fabric weights from 91 to 760 gsm. Every item carries the same quantity ladder: about 5% off the per-item price at 6-29 pieces, about 10% at 30-99 and about 20% at 100 or more, so the listed price is the one-to-five-piece rate. Visitors outside the US see the prices in their own currency (euros from the Netherlands). The honest catch is margin rather than fees. Printify's lower product and shipping costs mean noticeably higher profit per sale, while Tapstitch's heavyweight hooded pieces, at 345 gsm and up, start between $14.92 and $38.99. Price the finished garment against your retail price, not the platform. On 17 November 2026, in our own account (display currency euros, store billing currency USD), the catalogue showed 1,403 items, and the Essential Cotton tee (#RT0063) started at 5.45 euros for 1 to 5 pieces (5.18, 4.91 and 4.36 euros at 6, 30 and 100 or more) plus 2.61 euros per printed area, with shipping and taxes on top; we did not read the US dollar range again that day. The Shopify App Store listing seen in the same session said product prices start at $4.50 and showed 4.9 from 147 reviews.

claims.observed: On the product page of the Essential Cotton T-Shirt the unit price was EUR 5.45 for 1 to 5 pieces, EUR 5.18 for 6 to 29, EUR 4.91 for 30 to 99 and EUR 4.36 from 100, which is about 5%, 10% and 20% below the first price. Only this one tee was read, not every item.
claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take
claims.comparability: Four unit prices of one tee against the percentages in the review; the other items were not opened.
claims.buying_consequence: For a first test order the 1 to 5 price applies, and the ladder only matters from 6 pieces up.

claims.observed: The paths /pricing, /plans, /membership and /subscription gave a 404 and the wallet showed only a credit balance, a card field and a billing currency, so no plan was seen; this is the absence of a plan in the places we looked, not a statement of Tapstitch itself.
claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take
claims.comparability: Four page paths and the wallet pages against a review that says there is no subscription; the account settings were not searched for a plan.
claims.buying_consequence: Nothing to cancel and no monthly fee was seen, but the costs per item and the shipping still add up per order.

claims.observed: The catalogue All Products showed 1403 items on 17 November 2026 with Deliver to Netherlands, where the review says 1,244 items read on 12 October 2026; the lowest and highest price of the catalogue were not read, the tee started at EUR 5.45 and the hoodie at EUR 20.45.
claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take
claims.comparability: A count in a catalogue read on 17 November against a count read on 12 October, with prices in euros against a review in US dollars.

claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take

claims.buying_consequence: Read the size table and order one sample before you sell; the table alone does not say how a size fits.

claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take
claims.comparability: The currency of the screens against the review text on euros; the billing currency of an order was not tested.
claims.buying_consequence: Prices on screen are in euros, but the wallet bills in US dollars, so expect a currency conversion on the card side.

claims.observed: The designer showed Blank garment EUR 5.45, + Print Front EUR 2.61 ~ EUR 3.04 and Total Price EUR 8.06 ~ EUR 8.49, excluding shipping and taxes. No product was saved and no cart, order or checkout was reached, so no total with shipping and taxes was seen.
claims.plan: No plan was taken; Tapstitch has no plan to take

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session first installed the Shopify app of Tapstitch on a development store, which sent us at once to a separate Tapstitch login, and then tested in the Tapstitch dashboard with the own Tapstitch our account. An Essential Cotton T-Shirt reached the mockup in about 11 minutes from the start (about 4 minutes of onboarding and about 12 clicks from the catalogue), although the WordArt style showed a placeholder and not the own text. The designer showed EUR 5.45 for the blank tee plus EUR 2.61 to EUR 3.04 for a front print, EUR 8.06 to EUR 8.49 in total excluding shipping and taxes, the unit price fell to EUR 4.36 from 100 pieces, the catalogue had 1403 items and the size guide gave inches and centimetres. No plan page was found; nothing was saved, ordered or paid, and checkout, cancelling, fit and print quality were not tested. Two attempts. First attempt, through the Shopify app: the Shopify app Tapstitch: Print on Demand (App Store listing read at the time: Free to install, Additional charges may apply, rating 4.9 from 147 reviews, Products prices start at $4.50, All charges are billed in USD) was installed at about 20:00 on our development store. The app sent us at once to the login of Tapstitch (Welcome back, Sign in with Google, e-mail and password, and Dont have an account? Sign up), so it only opens with a separate Tapstitch account. Nothing was filled in, no account was made there and the app was uninstalled again. Second attempt, in the dashboard of Tapstitch with the own Tapstitch our account (made on 17 November 2026, interface in English, display currency EUR): the test started at 20:24 on the onboarding page and went through six questions (what to do with the creations: To sell to customers; types of apparel: Tees; how did you hear about us: Search or AI tools; where to sell: Online; main platform: Shopify, only ticked, nothing connected; a website: I dont have a website). Then a screen with exclusive offers and a 10% discount code appeared (not used), and the dashboard offered Connect your store, Design your first product and Customize your branding. Nothing was connected. Core action, a T-shirt with text up to the mockup: Dashboard, Design now, the catalogue All Products with 1403 items and Deliver to Netherlands. The tee Essential Cotton T-Shirt #RT0063 (Unisex, S to 3XL, 10 colors, 260 gsm, 7.7 oz, From EUR 5.45) was opened in the designer; the pop-up about AI images (Beta offer: 200 free tokens each day) was not clicked. Text was added with Text and the WordArt style, and the own text Test Brand was typed, but the style kept showing add text here, so the text layer on the mockup is a placeholder and not the own text. The tab Mockup showed the shirt at 20:35, about 11 minutes after the start, of which about 4 minutes were onboarding, and about 12 clicks from the catalogue. The screen says that mockups are for reference only and that final placement, size and colour match the design on the canvas as closely as possible. Prices as shown: in the designer Blank garment EUR 5.45, + Print Front EUR 2.61 ~ EUR 3.04, Total Price EUR 8.06 ~ EUR 8.49 and *Excluding shipping and taxes. On the product page the unit price falls with the quantity: 1-5 Pieces EUR 5.45, 6-29 Pieces EUR 5.18, 30-99 Pieces EUR 4.91, 100 or more Pieces EUR 4.36 (about 5%, 10% and 20% below the 1-5 price). A print costs EUR 2.61 per frame for Front, Back, Left Sleeve and Right Sleeve; techniques DTG, DTF and Embroidery; fulfilment International Fulfillment; shipping is Final shipping cost will be calculated at checkout; Available with seel (US only). The hoodie Essential Heavyweight Hoodie #RW0016 (430 gsm, 12.7 oz) showed From EUR 20.45. Size guide: the Size Guide of the tee has the tabs Inches and Centimeters, and lists length, shoulder, chest and sleeve length for S to 3XL, for example chest 50 cm (19.68 in) for S, 57.5 cm (22.64 in) for XL and 62.5 cm (24.61 in) for 3XL, with the line that actual measurements may vary by 1 to 3 cm (0.4 to 1.2 in). Only the table was read: no garment was ordered or worn, so whether an XL fits as expected was not tested. Plans: no subscription plan or pricing page was found (the paths /pricing, /plans, /membership and /subscription gave a 404), and the payment is per item. The page Wallet, Payments showed Your Credit USD 0.00, a block Payment card with Add credit/debit card (not clicked, no stored card), Store billing currency USD and Transactions with Nothing here yet. The Enterprise page has a contact form with a phone number (not filled in) and a banner 10% OFF with a countdown of 6 days. Differences: the review says 1,244 items from $2.99 to $38.99 (read on 12 October 2026), and the catalogue showed 1403 items on 17 November 2026 (in euros, with Deliver to Netherlands); the price fields are not changed here. The wallet currency (USD) differs from the euro prices shown in the catalogue and the designer, and what an order would charge in which currency was not tested. Checkout: NOT reached, no product was saved, no item was put in a cart, no sample or order was started, and no card or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: not tested, there was no plan to cancel and the account was not deleted. Not tested: feel of the fabric and print quality (no sample), real delivery time, the Shopify connection and Push to Store, a margin comparison with Printify, the fine print on shipping cost, the 10% code, Order Settings and deleting the account. Clean up: the designer was left with Exit without saving, so no test product exists; no cart item, no Shopify connection and no card. The our account stays, and the Shopify app was uninstalled after the first attempt. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Shopify app only opens with a separate Tapstitch account (login at once after the install); the WordArt style did not take over the typed text and showed add text here; the display currency was euros while the wallet bills in US dollars; and shipping and taxes are not in the designer price, so the real cost of one printed tee is not known before checkout.
